description.narrative:
NLRC will provide tailor-made support to each SNS in line with the Community Engagement and Accountability (CEA) and the Protection, Gender and Inclusion (PGI) guidelines of the IFRC and complementary to the support provided for by other Red Cross Partner National Societies (PNS). The support will follow a structure of first strengthening, or even establishing, a CEA mechanism with formalized CEA procedures, ranging from needs assessments to feedback mechanisms, in the SNS, by means of programmes that are tailored to the specific identified gaps of CEA within those SNSs. Once a sustainably functional mechanisms is set in place, CEA will be mainstreamed in all technical programming aspects and become a key aspect in PCM of all the work of the SNS independent of project-based funding.
This support will be provided for by a regional roving CEA delegate, who is supported by the regional IFRC CEA focal points in the respective regions.

Strengthening the downward accountability of Red Cross National Societies with an approach taking into account protection, gender and inclusion will ensure that the support provided to the communities and individuals is always based on an analysis of how each individual is affected differently by shocks and crisis ensuring that no one is left behind in the support delivered by the Red Cross.
Sudan, South Sudan, Ivory Coast, Zambia, Mali.

The CEA Boost programme is coordinated by a CEA Programme Manager and Advisor based at HQ who will travel to the six countries where NLRC is implementing the CEA Boost programme to enhance the downward accountability of Red Cross Sister National Societies (SNS). NLRC HQ is reserving budget under this project to provide top-ups to those SNS who progress well in the project.
